evidence.reason: The marker persistence path fsyncs only the token file descriptor and never fsyncs the parent directory after creation or removal. Because the code explicitly treats marker persistence as required and raises RecoveryRequired when persistence fails, a power loss can drop the newly created directory entry or leave a stale entry after unlink despite the file fsync succeeding. That can lose the admission hold or leave an unsynced stale hold after reboot. This is an implementation gap in the existing durability behavior, not a new requirement.
